# Emotion

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Emotion`](gmeow-Emotion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Emotion>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

An emotion as an intrinsic mode inhering in one agent (the [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)/Intention grounding). Episodic temporal scope rides [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil on the statement — deliberately no tenure class (thin means thin). Whether an emotion is self-reported or attributed is the vantage axis of the claims about it; self-report is top authority for the subject's own standpoint.
